propositions: The bridge fsck tool advertises and emits orphaned, duplicates, and stale checks that depend on legacy SYNC events never written by rebar, causing those cells to remain permanently empty and requiring removal from output and schema

Unknown event type detection must move from full JSON walk to a Git-based two-stage ref scan without checkout, using git grep on refs/heads/tickets followed by targeted blob reads for non-comment/non-compiled-state top-level event_type values

Store integrity audit must validate that every confirmed forward binding entry has a non-empty Jira key and a matching reverse entry, and every reverse entry points to a confirmed forward entry with the same Jira key, reporting six distinct finding kinds for any mismatch

Git operational failures including missing executable, missing ref, malformed grep output, grep exit >=2, or blob read failure must raise RebarError with returncode=2, map to CLI exit 2, and prevent a clean audit result

The public library, TypedDict, MCP model, JSON schema, and CLI must all transition from three removed keys (orphaned, duplicates, stale) to three committed keys (unknown_event_types, binding_drift, store_integrity), with non-empty store_integrity findings gating exit 1 and unknown_event_types remaining informational

All phantom SYNC-dependent scan arms, fixtures, constants (_STALE_THRESHOLD_NS, _NS_THRESHOLD, _to_ns, --now-ts), and legacy liveness detection must be removed while preserving live BRIDGE_ALERT emitter, reducer, and bridge-status compatibility entrypoint
